GOOD TO KNOW

A few things
you might be wondering.

Is CuePrompt really free?

Yes. Script editing, scrolling, mirror mode, fullscreen, and browser recording are free. No account is required.

Are my scripts private?

Your scripts are saved in local storage on this browser. We don't upload your scripts or recordings. Clearing browser data removes saved drafts. Export important scripts using the Download script button.

Can I use it on my phone?

Yes. CuePrompt adapts to mobile, tablet, and desktop browsers. Camera recording requires HTTPS and browser camera and microphone permissions; support varies by browser.

How do I record and download my video?

Choose Camera & record, allow camera and microphone access, then press Record. Stop recording to download the video in your browser's supported format. The script is shown on screen and is not embedded in the video.

Can I use it with a physical teleprompter?

Turn on Mirror text to flip the script horizontally for beam-splitter glass. Adjust text size and scroll speed, then enter fullscreen to focus on your delivery.
